body:
Audit finding 9, tracked by #719. Reproduced on develop `206b688768cc49c3210472668e6e3c63959e043f` (2026-10-12). No correction is included in this report.

## Problem and reproduction

Enable features `compression,performance`. Use `performance::streaming_writer::{StreamingPdfWriter, StreamingOptions, StreamingPageContent, PageResources, ContentStream}`. Create a file, write one page (width 612, height 792, default resources, content_streams = vec![ContentStream::new(b"0 0 10 10 re f".to_vec())]), and finalize.

Actual: create/write_page_streaming/finalize succeed; `qpdf --check` exits 2 and reports invalid xref/object structure and a Pages loop. The writer opens a page object, emits another indirect stream before closing it, fails to account for offsets consistently and estimates Kids as 3+i*2.

This is the alternate performance writer, not the main Document writer.

Source: [performance/streaming_writer.rs:192](https://github.com/bzsanti/oxidizePdf/blob/206b688768cc49c3210472668e6e3c63959e043f/oxidize-pdf-core/src/performance/streaming_writer.rs#L192).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Finalization produces complete non-nested indirect objects with accurate recorded IDs and offsets.
- [ ] Build Pages/Kids using actual allocated references, including multiple streams per page.
- [ ] Independent qpdf checks and reader page counts pass for one/multiple pages and empty/nonempty streams.
- [ ] Existing creation/options/statistics tests must be supplemented with checks of the finalized graph; explicitly disable unsupported output rather than returning success.
- [ ] Establish the independent behavior contract before updating expectations; retain positive/negative controls and demonstrate that the regression test fails on the audited source.

## Evidence and scope

Local audit evidence is retained in `docs/reports/2026-10-12-design-policy-audit-evidence/reproductions/` (probe sources, Cargo manifest/lock, logs and per-finding results). These are workspace artifacts, not claimed to be committed or downloadable from this issue. The reproduction and observations above are included here so triage does not depend on those paths. Claude’s independent review is still pending; these are executed findings from the primary audit, not attributed to Claude.
title: fix(performance): emit valid object graph and xref from StreamingPdfWriter
